verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly identifies an AI interview-preparation chapter as a proposed second-edition addition.
The client makes the AI chapter mandatory, specifies prompts, techniques, and tools, and establishes the short-chapter expectation.
In response to the AI chapter word-count question, the client gives a flexible guideline of approximately 2,500 to 3,500 words per chapter.
The client defines the AI chapter as a basic non-Q&A chapter, tightens its length limit, and requires editorial approval; the removed keys existed previously and are replaced by the new semantics.
The client terminates the entire project, removing the outstanding AI chapter deliverable.
